name: Millhouse Manastorm
guide_text: You MUST play a cycle comp on this hero such as APM Pirates or Elementals - NOT Undeads, Beast, or Mechs!
buddy_guide_text: Level up to tavern 4 on turn 6, and buddy up on turn 7. Great buddy that's worth 4 gold a turn!
